hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In the shadows of our London manor, where whispers of the past echo through the halls, I stumbled upon the new maid, Betty. She was sweeping the cobblestone street, her dress brushing against the stone as she moved, a sight to behold in the soft, morning light.
caption:
Caught her in the act! 🕯️️
